{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit top: fitted, long sleeves, soft scoop neckline, hip length, ruby red (#B3123B), merino wool with a little silk
Skirt: bias-cut midi, mid-calf length, with a gentle flow, black (#1B1B1F), matte satin
Outer layer: tailored wrap coat, knee length, with a belt and a notched collar, deep camel (#B98B5E), wool-cashmere blend
Ankle boots: pointed toe, slim block heel, ankle height, black (#141414), smooth leather
Bag: small structured top-handle bag, black (#141414), leather with a gold clasp
Earrings: medium drop earrings, gold tone (#C9A227), polished metal
Tights: sheer, black (#000000), fine matte knit

Why this outfit works: The ruby red knit is the bold statement, and it stands out in warm restaurant lighting while staying within a neat, refined dress level. The flowing satin skirt adds movement and a touch of evening glamour against the clean lines of the knit. Black boots and accessories keep the look sharp, with gold earrings adding a small flash of light. The camel coat keeps you warm on an autumn evening and gives the red a calm backdrop when you arrive and take it off."}
